messages:
lee: Quick UX check on the Private setup wizard network step. When multiple probes fail the page feels noisy. Thinking a compact list + inline status badges.

ana: Agree. Compact list is nice if the primary action (Retry probe) stays visible. Maybe show icon + short msg + Retry probe button on one line.

tom: For failures, show a prominent "View remediation" link next to Retry probe. Copy: 'View remediation' > 'Help'.

morgan: Accessibility: use aria-live="polite" for status updates and aria-controls on expand. Ensure color not sole indicator — add icons and bold text.

a11y-bot: Reminder: prefer-reduced-motion respected for any attention animations. Also contrast of warning text must be >=4.5:1.

lee: Mobile: shorten messages: 'Agent unreachable — check SSH 22 & CIDR.' Add a sticky summary with counts (passing / failing) that filters the list.

ana: Logs: parsed summary first, raw logs behind a toggle 'Show raw output'. Toggle needs aria-expanded and an accessible label.

tom: I'll mock the compact row + filters and post a Loom.

morgan: I'll draft ARIA attributes and QA checklist.

lee: Thanks — sync in 15. :thumbsup:
